notesDetails.title: OTP 28 BEAM Bytecode Decompilation in Reconnaissance & ~200 ms Boot-Window SIGUSR2 Race in ./cb
bullets: Decompiling `:erl_signal_handler` & `:httpc_handler` Abstract Code Upfront (Turns 13 & 17–19, Lines 60 & 72–78): Before writing a single project file, the agent extracted `:abstract_code` chunks from OTP 28's compiled `.beam` modules via `:beam_lib.chunks/2`. Confirming `:httpc_handler`'s `clobber_and_retry/1` + `retry_pipeline/2` auto-retry queues and `SIGUSR1`'s default crash dump (`erl_crash.dump`), it built a zero-dependency 396-line `CapyBench.HTTPClient` (`:gen_tcp`/`:ssl` with `:verify_peer`, `:public_key.pkix_verify_hostname_match_fun(:https)`, and `log_level: :none`) and a 39-line `CapyBench.SignalHandler` on `:sigusr2`. When an early untimed PTY probe (`Turn 7`, Line 40) crossed 60s and moved to background job `bg_1`, the agent read `proc://bg_1/streams` and terminated it cleanly via `proc://bg_1/kill` (Line 43).

Subtle ~200 ms Startup Signal Race vs. `gemini-4-carbon`: Once `CapyBench.Runner.run/2` registers `CapyBench.SignalHandler` (`>= 0.25s` after launch), foreground PTY `Ctrl-C` while pacing, during slow/stalled in-flight requests, and against live `https://rizafahmi.com` (`36/36` HTTP `200`s on full 5s run) cleanly prints the partial summary and exits `130`. However, because `./cb` launches `"$escript_path" "$@" &` without `( trap '' USR2; ... )` and defers `:os.set_signal(:sigusr2, :handle)` until `Runner.run/2`, pressing `Ctrl-C` during the first ~200 ms BEAM escript boot window hits POSIX default `SIGUSR2` termination (`User defined signal 2: 31`, exit `159`, no summary).

notesDetails.title: 38% Fewer Turns & 33% Lower Cost Than gemini-4-carbon via Parallel Tool Batching (1.86 Tools/Turn)
bullets: Controlled `omp` Ablation (`gemini-4-argon` vs. `gemini-4-carbon`): Under identical `omp` flags and `$2.00/$0.10/$10.00` token rates, `gemini-4-argon` completed all 7 stages in `132` LLM turns and `52m 53s` (`$3.97`, `18.29M` tokens; `782` production LoC across 5 modules + `1,408` test LoC) vs. `gemini-4-carbon`'s `214` turns and `63m 24s` (`$5.91`, `27.47M` tokens). The primary driver was parallel tool batching: `76` of `132` turns (`57.6%`) emitted multiple tool calls (up to `6` in a single turn, averaging `1.86` tools/turn vs. `1.18` on `gemini-4-carbon`).

Exact Audit of All 33 Tool Errors (`29 bash` + `4 edit`): Out of `29` non-zero `bash` exits across `99` shell calls, `16` were deliberate red-phase TDD `mix test` runs verifying new tests failed first (`S1` Lines 94, 110; `S2` Lines 188, 198, 208, 218, 233, 245; `S3` Lines 302, 316, 348, 365; `S4` Line 403; `S5` Line 504; `S6` Line 540; `S7` Line 584), `5` were `mix credo --strict` readability/refactoring gates (`Lines 262, 383, 476, 611, 618`), `4` were single-turn compile fixes (`Lines 223, 325, 410, 433`), and `4` were disposable OTP/TLS probes (`Line 133` nested `ProbeHandler` alias + `Lines 281, 287, 290` X.509 SAN probes). Across `72` `edit` and `15` `write` calls, `omp` hashline guardrails rejected `4` invalid patches before touching disk (`3` unseen-line range anchors at `Lines 154, 323, 565` and `1` invented hash tag `#3470` vs. `#BB64` at `Line 616`).

notesDetails.title: Zero Mid-Run Prefix Cache Evictions (97.57% Cache Hit Rate, $33.67 Saved) & 80.8% Inference Wall-Clock
bullets: Unit Economics & $33.67 Cache Savings: Across `132` turns, `gemini-4-argon` processed `18,161,471` prompt tokens (`440,506` uncached at `$2.00/1M` = `$0.8810` + `17,720,965` cached at `$0.10/1M` = `$1.7721`; `97.57%` cache hit rate) and `131,691` output tokens including `61,473` reasoning tokens at `$10.00/1M` (`$1.3169`), totaling `18,293,162` tokens and `$3.9700` (`$3.97`, or `$7.94` under the 2027 `$4.00/$0.20/$20.00` schedule). Without the 95% cache discount, the run would have cost `$37.64` (`89.5%` saved).

131/131 Post-Initial Cache Hits: Only Turn 1 (`Line 9`, `5,682` tokens) had `cacheRead: 0`; all `131` subsequent turns hit the prefix cache cleanly as prompt context grew monotonically from `5,682` to `294,420` tokens (`295,157` total tokens on Turn 131, `28.08%` of `1,048,576`, `0` compactions)—avoiding the two mid-S3 cache evictions that added `$0.56` to `gemini-4-carbon`.

80.8% Inference vs. 19.2% Tool Wall-Clock Split: LLM inference consumed `42m 43.3s` (`2,563.3s`, avg `19.42s/turn`, avg TTFT `13.26s`, peaking at `74.7s` and `5,952` reasoning tokens on Turn 88 in S4 and `73.3s` / `4,246` reasoning tokens on Turn 68 in S3), while all `246` tool executions took `10m 10.1s` (`610.1s`), primarily seven ~48–51s all-async full-suite `mix test` runs from S4 through Release Verification.
